name: entityresolution
description: Welcome to the Entity Resolution API Reference.

subcommands.name: add-policy-statement
subcommands.description: Adds a policy statement object.

subcommands.name: batch-delete-unique-id
subcommands.description: Deletes multiple unique IDs in a matching workflow.

subcommands.name: create-id-mapping-workflow
subcommands.description: Creates an IdMappingWorkflow object which stores the configuration of the data processing job to be run.

subcommands.name: create-id-namespace
subcommands.description: Creates an ID namespace object which will help customers provide metadata explaining their dataset and how to use it.

subcommands.name: create-matching-workflow
subcommands.description: Creates a matching workflow that defines the configuration for a data processing job.

subcommands.name: create-schema-mapping
subcommands.description: Creates a schema mapping, which defines the schema of the input customer records table.

subcommands.name: delete-id-mapping-workflow
subcommands.description: Deletes the IdMappingWorkflow with a given name.

subcommands.name: delete-id-namespace
subcommands.description: Deletes the IdNamespace with a given name.

subcommands.name: delete-matching-workflow
subcommands.description: Deletes the MatchingWorkflow with a given name.

subcommands.name: delete-policy-statement
subcommands.description: Deletes the policy statement.

subcommands.name: delete-schema-mapping
subcommands.description: Deletes the SchemaMapping with a given name.

subcommands.name: generate-match-id
subcommands.description: Generates or retrieves Match IDs for records using a rule-based matching workflow.

subcommands.name: get-id-mapping-job
subcommands.description: Returns the status, metrics, and errors (if there are any) that are associated with a job.

subcommands.name: get-id-mapping-workflow
subcommands.description: Returns the IdMappingWorkflow with a given name, if it exists.

subcommands.name: get-id-namespace
subcommands.description: Returns the IdNamespace with a given name, if it exists.

subcommands.name: get-match-id
subcommands.description: Returns the corresponding Match ID of a customer record if the record has been processed in a rule-based matching workflow.

subcommands.name: get-matching-job
subcommands.description: Returns the status, metrics, and errors (if there are any) that are associated with a job.

subcommands.name: get-matching-workflow
subcommands.description: Returns the MatchingWorkflow with a given name, if it exists.

subcommands.name: get-policy
subcommands.description: Returns the resource-based policy.

subcommands.name: get-provider-service
subcommands.description: Returns the ProviderService of a given name.

subcommands.name: get-schema-mapping
subcommands.description: Returns the SchemaMapping of a given name.

subcommands.name: list-id-mapping-jobs
subcommands.description: Lists all ID mapping jobs for a given workflow.

subcommands.name: list-id-mapping-workflows
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all the IdMappingWorkflows that have been created for an Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-id-namespaces
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all ID namespaces.

subcommands.name: list-matching-jobs
subcommands.description: Lists all jobs for a given workflow.

subcommands.name: list-matching-workflows
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all the MatchingWorkflows that have been created for an Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-provider-services
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all the ProviderServices that are available in this Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: list-schema-mappings
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all the SchemaMappings that have been created for an Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Displays the tags associated with an Entity Resolution resource.

subcommands.name: put-policy
subcommands.description: Updates the resource-based policy.

subcommands.name: start-id-mapping-job
subcommands.description: Starts the IdMappingJob of a workflow.

subcommands.name: start-matching-job
subcommands.description: Starts the MatchingJob of a workflow.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Assigns one or more tags (key-value pairs) to the specified Entity Resolution resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tags from the specified Entity Resolution resource.

subcommands.name: update-id-mapping-workflow
subcommands.description: Updates an existing IdMappingWorkflow.

subcommands.name: update-id-namespace
subcommands.description: Updates an existing ID namespace.

subcommands.name: update-matching-workflow
subcommands.description: Updates an existing matching workflow.

subcommands.name: update-schema-mapping
subcommands.description: Updates a schema mapping.
